bike_path.whereNote: Inside City parks only. A designated bikeway is open to bicycles under the first sentence of this clause, but the next sentence bars motorized vehicles except on roads made for cars. The record leaves open whether an e-bike counts as a motorized vehicle here.
bike_path.quote: Motorcycles or any other motorized vehicles are prohibited except on roads designated and established for automotive traffic.

sidewalk.whereNote: Sidewalks that front a commercial business establishment. Bicycles are allowed there only where official signs authorize it.
sidewalk.quote: No person shall operate a bicycle upon any sidewalk fronting any commercial business establishment unless official signs are posted authorizing such use.

sidewalk.whereNote: SDMC 84.04 bars riding any vehicle on any sidewalk. The record notes that Vehicle Code 670 excludes only devices moved exclusively by human power, so an e-bike may count as a vehicle here. The record leaves this open, so sidewalks that do not front a business stay unconfirmed.
sidewalk.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to ride, drive, propel, or cause to be propelled any vehicle or animal across or upon any sidewalk excepting over permanently constructed driveways and excepting when it is necessary for any temporary purpose to drive a loaded vehicle across a sidewalk

footway.whereNote: Inside City parks only. The code counts open space, beaches, bays, wetlands and perimeter sidewalks as parks. A bicycle may ride there only where posted to authorize it, on a designated bikeway, on a road made for cars, or on a park fire or service road. The record says to treat e-bikes on unposted park paths as not allowed.
footway.quote: Bicycles. It is unlawful to ride a bicycle except: (1) where posted to authorize bicycle riding; or (2) on any designated bikeway; or (3) on any road designated and established for automotive traffic; or (4) on paved and unpaved roads within a park used as fire or service roads by authorized motor vehicles unless otherwise posted.

trail.whereNote: Inside City parks only. The code counts open space, beaches, bays, wetlands and perimeter sidewalks as parks. A bicycle may ride there only where posted to authorize it, on a designated bikeway, on a road made for cars, or on a park fire or service road. The record says to treat e-bikes on unposted park paths as not allowed.
trail.quote: Bicycles. It is unlawful to ride a bicycle except: (1) where posted to authorize bicycle riding; or (2) on any designated bikeway; or (3) on any road designated and established for automotive traffic; or (4) on paved and unpaved roads within a park used as fire or service roads by authorized motor vehicles unless otherwise posted.

facilities.extent: The Pier Plaza, bounded on the south by First Street, on the north by the north side of the parking lot at the northwest intersection of The Strand and the Municipal Pier, on the east by the west side of Pacific Street, and on the west by the Pacific Ocean. It covers any sidewalk, roadway, parking lot or other way inside those lines. No OpenStreetMap name was found for the plaza on 2026-10-23, so the app cannot match it by name.
facilities.quote: It is prohibited to operate or ride on a mobility device in public areas where such prohibition is posted by signs or as otherwise set forth in section 5.14(b), (c), and (d).

facilities.extent: Libby Lake Park, except dedicated city streets and public parking lots. The code bars motorized vehicles and does not define the term or name electric bicycles.
facilities.quote: No person shall operate, ride, drive or in any manner propel any motorized vehicle, including but not limited to autos, trucks, motorcycles, and mini-bikes within any portion of Libby Lake Park except on dedicated city streets and established public parking lots

bike_path.whereNote: Recreational areas, which are parks, playgrounds, recreation centers and school athletic fields. EMC 18-67 defines vehicle as any conveyance, motor-powered or self-propelled. On its words this reaches e-bikes off paved park roads, but it says drive and EMC 18-92(b) assumes bicycles are ridden there. Unsettled.
bike_path.quote: No person shall drive any vehicle on any recreational area except the paved park roads or parking areas

bike_path.whereNote: Any public area where a no-ride sign is posted.
bike_path.quote: Bicycles, mobility devices, and nonmotorized vehicles are prohibited where posted. It is prohibited to operate or ride on a bicycle, mobility device, or nonmotorized vehicle in public areas where signs prohibiting such activity are posted.

sidewalk.whereNote: Every sidewalk, for electric bicycles of any class and any age. Ord. No. 2026-07 was adopted Sep 16, 2026. Its own recital says it takes effect 60 days after adoption, Nov 15, 2026, while the Government Code 36937 default would be Oct 16, 2026. So a ban in force on 2026-10-23 cannot be confirmed. It is certain from Nov 15, 2026.
sidewalk.quote: Mobility devices, such as electric bicycles and motor vehicles, are prohibited from operating on any sidewalk in the city.

bike_path.whereNote: Inside Vista parks and recreation facilities only. The code lets bicycles use paths designated for them and does not say how a path is designated, so a path built for bicycles is not confirmed. Title 12 does not define bicycle, so its reach to e-bikes rests on the words bicycle and any other vehicle.
bike_path.quote: Ride a bicycle, tricycle, motorcycle, motorcycle chopper, skateboards, scooters, or any other vehicle on any path, trail, walk, or any recreation facility, other than those designated for the same.

sidewalk.whereNote: Every sidewalk, for any age and every e-bike class. The only exception is locations in the City Bicycle Master Plan with proper signage and striping approved by the City Traffic Engineer. The record does not know which locations are signed and striped. VMC 10.68.060 also makes a bicycle operator dismount to use a sidewalk or crosswalk.
sidewalk.quote: It is unlawful for any person to ride or operate a bicycle upon any sidewalk in the city, with the exception of locations included in the City's Bicycle Master Plan with proper signage and striping as approved by the City's Traffic Engineer.

footway.whereNote: Inside Vista parks and recreation facilities only. The code bars riding on any path, trail or walk other than those designated for bicycles. Title 12 does not define bicycle, so its reach to e-bikes rests on the words bicycle and any other vehicle.
footway.quote: Ride a bicycle, tricycle, motorcycle, motorcycle chopper, skateboards, scooters, or any other vehicle on any path, trail, walk, or any recreation facility, other than those designated for the same.

trail.whereNote: Inside Vista parks and recreation facilities only. The code bars riding on any path, trail or walk other than those designated for bicycles. Title 12 does not define bicycle, so its reach to e-bikes rests on the words bicycle and any other vehicle.
trail.quote: Ride a bicycle, tricycle, motorcycle, motorcycle chopper, skateboards, scooters, or any other vehicle on any path, trail, walk, or any recreation facility, other than those designated for the same.

footway.whereNote: Inside parks, playgrounds and school grounds, unless the way is designated as a bicycle path or route. PMC 10.57.090(E) adds that e-bikes stay on the designated bike trails, pathways and roadways within parks.

footway.whereNote: Areas of a City Community Services facility that are designated and posted as a pedestrian walkway. The code uses the words vehicle and bicycle and does not name electric bicycles.
footway.quote: No person shall ride, operate or use any vehicle, skateboard, bicycle, scooter, roller skates or roller blades in any area of a City Community Services facility designated and posted as a pedestrian walkway.

trail.whereNote: Outside parks. Section 10.57.090(A) permits a bicycle trail, which the code defines as another name for a bicycle path, so it is not clear that it covers an unpaved trail. PMC 10.40.100 bars motorcycles and power cycles on riders’ and hikers’ trails and does not define power cycle. Signs decide. The record notes the city trails page says motorized vehicles are not permitted, but a web page is not enacted text.
trail.quote: Riding of electric bicycles on any sidewalk, bicycle path, bicycle trail, or roadway is permitted unless prohibited by appropriate signs authorized pursuant to the terms of this chapter.
